entries.1b1b501df510254c: It manufactures and sells electric wires and cables, wire harnesses, new energy-related products, and harness processing machinery and components. Some companies, including the company, outsource product processing to domestic and overseas subsidiaries and sell the products they purchase, while subsidiaries with both sales and manufacturing functions sell products they manufacture in-house.
entries.21cea1e9e2da184f: This segment manufactures and sells electric wires and cables, wire harnesses, new energy-related products, and harness processing machinery and parts in Japan. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥24,000 million. Demand increased in environment-related markets, while other markets were affected by delayed recovery in some market conditions and inventory adjustments by customers. It includes the company and consolidated subsidiaries such as Onamba Interconnect Technology Co., Ltd. and Union Machinery Co., Ltd.

entries.53f15cd0eebf5325: This segment manufactures, processes and sells electric wires in Asian countries including China, Vietnam, Indonesia and Thailand. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥8,536 million. While the Chinese market continued to be sluggish, demand recovered at some customers. It includes consolidated subsidiaries such as Ounanba Dianzi Peijian (Kunshan) Co., Ltd., VIETNAM ONAMBA CO.,LTD. and PT. ONAMBA INDONESIA.
entries.5566ce2c4b461d24: Based on its medium-term management plan 'PROGRESS 2026', the company aims to establish a growth base toward its 100th anniversary (2041) and to realize a 'global integrated wiring system manufacturer' suited to a new era of energy. It states that it will steadily execute growth strategies, production strategies, and efforts to strengthen its management base, with management mindful of cost of capital, and will pursue transformation of its business structure. Growth strategies include strengthening key growth strategies by division and efforts contributing to a decarbonized society; production strategies include strengthening domestic production bases, a global production base strategy, and building 'global uniform quality'.
